# monty-type-checking

Type checking for Monty sessions, powered by [ty](https://github.com/astral-sh/ty): checks code against Monty's trimmed typeshed before execution.


A top-level module a snippet imports (`a` for `import a.b` and `from a.b import c`).

Implements: `Debug`, `Eq`, `PartialEq`, `StructuralPartialEq`.

## SnippetImports

```rust
pub struct SnippetImports {
    /// Import statements with aliases, one per line, injected before later checks' `.pyi` star import.
    /// This preserves bindings such as `import math`, which `.pyi` files do not re-export.
    pub prelude: String,
    /// Each top-level module imported, once, in source order.
    pub modules: Vec<ImportedModule>,
}
```

## scan_imports

```rust
pub fn scan_imports(source: &str) -> SnippetImports;
```

<div class="rust-decl-links" data-links="SnippetImports #snippetimports" hidden></div>

Collects imports outside function and class bodies, excluding `__future__` and relative imports.
Invalid syntax yields no imports. All module-level branches are included because the checker
cannot tell which ran, and any names bound at runtime must resolve.

<div class="rust-decl-links" data-links="SourceFile #sourcefile;TypeCheckingConfig ../monty-types/#typecheckingconfig;TypeCheckingDiagnostics #typecheckingdiagnostics" hidden></div>

Type check some python source code, checking if it's valid to run with monty.

#### Arguments
* `python_source` - The python source code to type check.
* `stubs_file` - Optional stubs file to use for type checking.
* `config` - Configuration for the type checking diagnostics.

#### Returns
* `Ok(None)` - If there are no typing errors.
* `Ok(Some(string))` - If there are typing errors.
* `Err(String)` - If there was an unexpected/internal error during type checking, or the
  script path names the stubs file.

[`run`](#typechecker) with host module stubs and committed imports.
The prelude precedes the stubs' star import so later bindings shadow imports as at runtime.
Diagnostics use the snippet's original line numbers.

Implements: `Debug`, `Default`.

## TypeCheckingDiagnostics

```rust
pub struct TypeCheckingDiagnostics<'a> { /* private fields */ }
```

The diagnostics of one failed type check, rendered on `Display`.

Borrows the checker because ty's diagnostics only resolve their spans (file
paths, source snippets) against the database that produced them — which is
why the format is chosen up front, in [`TypeChecker::run`](#typechecker), and why callers
that outlive the checker (anything across a process boundary) must keep the
rendered string rather than this.

Implements: `Display`.
